artists.biography: Mark James Morriss (born 18 October 1971 in Hounslow, Middlesex) is an English singer-songwriter, formerly the lead singer for The Bluetones who split up in September 2011 following a farewell tour. He is the older brother of former bandmate and bass player/illustrator Scott Morriss and is currently pursuing a solo career.

perplexity.description:
The Taste of Mark Morriss, released in 2015 on the Acid Jazz label, is a covers album that showcases Mark Morriss's interpretations of various songs through a rock and pop lens. Positioned as his third solo album following Memory Muscle (2008) and A Flash of Darkness (2014), this record highlights Morriss's ability to reinterpret and personalize existing material rather than presenting original compositions. The album's style blends Morriss’s characteristic melodic sensibility with a polished production typical of Acid Jazz releases, emphasizing both his vocal delivery and nuanced instrumental arrangements.

Commercially, The Taste of Mark Morriss achieved modest chart success, reaching number 91 on the UK Albums Chart and performing better on independent charts, including number 38 on the Independent Albums Chart and charting on the Independent Album Breakers Chart. Critically, it was noted for its thoughtful selection of covers and Morriss’s distinctive approach, which balances respect for the originals with his own artistic voice. This album occupies a unique place in Morriss’s discography as a reflective project that bridges his earlier folk-tinged solo work and subsequent releases, illustrating his versatility within the rock and pop genres.
